title: Accept and report rizzstack.ticket/1 claims at POST /v1/attempts (report mode only)

outcome.summary: POST /v1/attempts accepts an optional brief.ticket claims object and, when ticket_mode is report, validates it against the vendored schemas/rizzstack-ticket.schema.json (draft 2020-12, twelve ADR claims, no unknown claims). The attempt is always accepted: the outcome is persisted and returned as ticket_report with status missing|valid|invalid, a violations list whose entries name the failing claim, and signature "not_checked". ticket_mode defaults to off, accepts only off|report, is read from config only (no environment variable), and refuses enforce at load. No signature verification, crypto import or key material is added; C4 owns verification and wave D owns JCS.
observable_behavior: With ticket_mode off, a create with no ticket and a create with a malformed ticket are both accepted exactly as before; neither the response nor the attempt journal gains a ticket_report key.
With ticket_mode report, a schema-invalid ticket is accepted and recorded as ticket_report.status=invalid with ticket_invalid violations whose detail names the failing claim (e.g. source_rev).
With ticket_mode report, a brief with no ticket is accepted and recorded as ticket_report.status=missing with one ticket_missing violation.
A claims set with the ADR's twelve claims validates against schemas/rizzstack-ticket.schema.json and is recorded as ticket_report.status=valid with no violations.

Every report carries signature="not_checked"; a JWS-shaped string is treated as an invalid claims object, never verified; launcher.py gains no crypto import and the vendored schema holds no key material.
ticket_mode defaults to off, accepts off|report, refuses enforce with ValueError at load_config, and HYYV_TICKET_MODE/TICKET_MODE/RIZZSTACK_TICKET_MODE/BUNDLEBEES_TICKET_MODE do not change it.

interfaces.name: POST /v1/attempts
interfaces.notes: Additive: brief.ticket is optional; in report mode the 200/201 body gains ticket_report. No new refusal status in this slice.

interfaces.name: launcher.load_config
interfaces.notes: Defaults ticket_mode to off and refuses any value other than off|report.

interfaces.name: launcher.ticket_violations
interfaces.notes: Pure validator over the vendored schema: claims object in, list of {code, detail} out (empty means valid). No crypto, no network, no key material.

interfaces.name: launcher.ticket_report
interfaces.notes: Builds {schema: rizzstack.ticket-report/1, mode, status, violations, signature: not_checked} from cfg and brief.

interfaces.name: schemas/rizzstack-ticket.schema.json
interfaces.notes: Vendored copy of workflow #171 (commit 6fed14c): draft 2020-12, title rizzstack.ticket/1, twelve required claims, additionalProperties false.

acceptance_criteria.statement: a brief with no ticket is accepted unchanged and no ticket_report appears in the response or journal
ticket_mode off ignores a malformed ticket, stores the brief as sent and records no report
report mode accepts a malformed ticket, records ticket_invalid and names source_rev in the violations
report mode accepts a missing ticket and records exactly one ticket_missing violation
the twelve ADR claims validate against the vendored schema and are reported valid
reports say signature not_checked and the slice adds no signature verification, crypto import or key material
ticket_mode defaults to off, accepts report, refuses enforce and ignores the candidate environment variables

dependencies: wave-c-C1: workflow schemas/rizzstack-ticket.schema.json (6fed14c) is the source of the vendored copy
wave-b-B1: the parsable /v1 contract this endpoint surface is described against
assumptions: brief.ticket carries the decoded claims object in C2; the compact JWS form arrives with C4 verification.
C2 does not recompute brief_sha256 or compare claims to the brief; wave D's RFC 8785 core and C4 own that.

reasons: changes the admission surface every bee create crosses (/v1/attempts)
first hyvv half of the ADR 0002 security boundary; a report that looks like enforcement would mislead rollouts

review.approved_by: owner standing approval for waves B/C and Part 2 (2026-11-25)
